basis: Non-exhaustive reference leads for core capabilities, not certified full feasibility. References primarily use the frozen public directory descriptions; official documentation cross-checks are recorded in the protocol. No reference list is supplied to the search engine.

cases.query: I am building a walking trip planner and need hourly weather forecasts for the next few days.
Find cafes that have specialty coffee and match coffee to user preferences for bean origin and roast.
cases.review: A places lead is useful but does not establish cafe bean inventory or roast coverage.

cases.query: Send appointment reminders to customers by SMS. I need delivery, not phone-number validation.
Send order confirmation emails from my small online shop, not verify email addresses.
Accept customer card payments at checkout in my online shop.
cases.review: Do not infer payment capability solely from provider reputation.

cases.query: Translate the text customers write into another human language in my app.
Turn an HTML invoice into a downloadable PDF file.
Extract readable text from photos of printed documents.
Estimate the country and city a visitor is in from their IP address.
Show prices converted between currencies using the latest exchange rates.
Look up book titles and authors from an ISBN for my personal library app.
List Canadian public holidays by province in a leave-planning app.
Convert street addresses to latitude and longitude for delivery locations.
Upload customer-selected files into their Google Drive, with their permission.
Add each new form response as a row in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
Create a GitHub issue whenever a customer submits a bug report.
Scan a product barcode and look up its name, brand and image, not generate barcode images.
An MCP server that gives my coding assistant captured screenshots and console or network evidence for a bug.
cases.review: Metadata fit only; no install, safety review or tool execution.

cases.query: Find the official Microsoft Playwright MCP server for browser automation.
Write a birthday poem for my friend. I do not need an API or a product.
Find YouTube videos about learning guitar and show their titles in my app.
Read upcoming events from a consenting user's Google Calendar for a daily agenda.
Convert recorded voice notes into written transcripts, not turn text into audio.
Let people search recipes and see the ingredients needed to cook them.
Show a feed of the latest New York Times articles with titles and links.
Help sailors plan a trip using hourly marine weather conditions.
Calculate a driving route between a pickup address and a drop-off location, with waypoints.
An MCP connector to look up Tandem documentation, installation instructions and SDK guides.
Find the official GitHub MCP server to connect an assistant to my repositories.
Thanks, that is all. Goodbye!
